name: Vimium C
keyMappings:
# One-handed, right-hand Dvorak (One-Handed Fedora Remix). e h t d = left down up right.
unmapAll
map ' showHelp
map e scrollLeft
map h scrollDown
map t scrollUp
map d scrollRight
map o goBack
map u goForward
map r scrollPageDown
map s scrollPageUp
map y scrollToTop
map b scrollToBottom
map a previousTab
map c nextTab
map k removeTab
map j restoreTab
map l Vomnibar.activate
map m Vomnibar.activateTabs
map f Vomnibar.activateBookmarks
map i LinkHints.activate
map n LinkHints.activateOpenInNewTab
map w LinkHints.activateCopyLinkUrl
map / enterFindMode
map v performFind
map g performBackwardsFind
map ; focusInput
map = reload
